budget.note: Sponsor left the budget blank. Default set by the orchestrator (ADR-002). Red flag at 80%.

concurrency.note: Harness caps each workflow at 2 concurrent agents on this 4-CPU container (ADR-000). Up to 3 workflows run side by side.

pricingSource: Anthropic first-party list prices, cached 2026-10-06 (claude-api skill). Cache-read rate for Haiku 5.5 assumed at 10% of input.
storyPoints: Fibonacci 1,2,3,5,8,13. Calibration: 1pt ≈ one focused file with tests; 8pt ≈ a module with API, storage and tests.

performance.lowPerformer: bottom 10% by composite score, or below target two sprints running; fewer than 3 tickets = low confidence, no action
